channel.title: The Christian Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Texas AG, securities board offer conflicting takes on latest lawsuit against proposed Muslim-focused community
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has filed a lawsuit targeting a proposed Muslim-focused residential community in North Texas, accusing developers of an "illegal development scheme" that violated state securities laws. #AGKenPaxton #Texas #EPICCity

item.title: MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell announces run for Minnesota governor: 'I'm still standing'
item.description: Mike Lindell announced his candidacy for the Minnesota gubernatorial race Thursday, throwing his hat into the race against former Democratic vice presidential candidate, Gov. Tim Walz, who is running for his third consecutive four-year term. #MikeLindell #Minnesota #MyPillow #TimWalz

item.title: Elon Musk blasts Gavin Newsom for taunting him over trans son: 'Evil woke mind virus'
item.description: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk hit back at Democratic California Gov. Gavin Newsom on Friday after the X account of Newsom's press office taunted him over his transgender-identifying son. #ElonMusk #GavinNewsom #transgender #California

item.title: ACNA inquiry board finds Archbishop Steve Wood should be put on trial for allegedly violating vows, sexual immorality
item.description: The head of the Anglican Church in North America should be put on trial for allegedly violating ordination vows and for sexual immorality, a denominational investigative body has concluded. #AnglicanChurchinNorthAmerica #boardofinquiry #sexualimmorality #court #ACNA #SteveWood

item.title: UMC pushes back on reported plan to 'geotarget' Texas churchgoers with pro-Israel messaging
item.description: A United Methodist Church official is pushing back against a controversial “geofencing” plan to target churchgoers in Texas and other states with messaging from an organization acting as an agent of the state of Israel. #UMC #Texas #Israel #unitedmethodistchurch #churches #ShowFaithbyWorks

item.title: World Vision distributes toys to children in Jamaica impacted by Hurricane Melissa
item.description: World Vision is distributing toys to children in Jamaica whose lives have been affected by Hurricane Melissa, as the long road to recovery on the hard-hit island nation continues. #WorldVision #HurricaneMelissa #Jamaica

item.title: Quebec City officials vote to remove crucifix displayed in council chamber
item.description: Quebec City officials have voted to remove a crucifix displayed in the city’s council chamber. The decision follows a recommendation to preserve the item in a heritage collection while reinforcing the principle of state “secularism.” #Canada #Secularism #QuebecCity #Crucifix #ReligiousSymbols #ChristianArtifacts

item.title: BLM executive director of OKC chapter charged with fraud, money laundering involving millions in donor funds
item.description: The executive director of a Black Lives Matter chapter in Oklahoma has been charged with wire fraud and money laundering involving millions of dollars in donor funds. Federal prosecutors say she used the money for personal travel, shopping and real estate. #BlackLivesMatter #Oklahoma #WireFraud #MoneyLaundering

item.title: Time magazine snubs Charlie Kirk, names AI 'architects' as 'Person of the Year'
item.description: Time magazine is facing backlash from one of conservative media’s biggest voices over its decision to snub Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk as its “Person of the Year” despite Kirk’s death marking the first major political assassination in the U.S. since the 1960s. #PersonoftheYear #CharlieKirk #AI #Timemagazine

item.title: Trump's week in review: White House defends Marty Makary, DOJ sues Minneapolis Public Schools
item.description: The Trump administration this week took additional actions to combat religious and racial discrimination and announced new updates in its ongoing efforts to secure the U.S. border. #Trump #MartyMakary #DHS #DOJ #illegals
